description: The actual result shows a floor-length russet-red noble gown with a low square neckline, fitted embroidered bodice, gold woven borders and patterned cream underdress. Long red and cream draped sleeve layers rest around the arms, with a narrow decorated belt and small gold pendant. The hands and dark shoes are visible; the figure stands upright and centered against an undecorated stone doorway. Skin and hair remain photographic. The image has no visible words, weapons, armor or banner.
